record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce tied item embedding width from 64 to 48, consistently resizing positional embeddings, prefix projection, normalization and convolution channels to match. Lower dimensional representations may regularize sparse item relationships and improve validation ranking. Retain the same six causal blocks, dilation pattern, embedding tying, initialization rule, input features, history policy, readout, dot-product scoring, loss, dropout and optimizer. Update checkpoint metadata and predictor construction consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce tied item embedding width from 64 to 48 across all four datasets to test whether lower capacity improves generalization. Existing hidden_units plumbing resizes positional embeddings, prefix projection, normalization and convolution channels, saves the width in checkpoint metadata, and reconstructs matching predictor shapes. Preserve the six causal blocks, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.
